name: effort-restart-re-deferred-by-a-new-turn
description: An effort change is queued mid-turn. The turn completes, but the next prompt starts a new turn before the deferred restart gets to run, so the restart is postponed again and happens only after that second turn completes, still resuming the same session.
reason: The deferred restart hops off the event delivery before it runs. A prompt that was already on its way (a second voice prompt, a protocol client's sendPrompt) can start a turn in that gap; restarting then would cut that answer off.
source: DESIGN.md v1.2 E '.cycleEffort'; AppState.handleHarnessEvent(.turnCompleted) 'A queued turn started already — wait for that one too.'

script.reason: App launch: a fresh session with effort high.
The first turn is in flight.
The first turn ends. The restart is scheduled to run once this delivery is over, but the next step arrives first.
A prompt already on its way starts a second turn before the deferred restart runs. The restart sees a turn in flight and postpones itself again.
The second turn is over: now the harness restarts with the new effort, resuming the same session.

transcript.text: Effort → Extra High (applies when this turn finishes)
Resuming the session with effort xhigh…
